# Introduction

The **`jjridges`** analysis (Ridge Plot) provides clinicopathological researchers and biostatisticians with intuitive, publication-ready tools in jamovi and R.

## Key Capabilities

- 'Create advanced ridgeline plots. Visualize distributions across groups with multiple style options, annotations, statistical overlays, and publication-ready formatting. Supports both basic and complex ridge plots with inside plots, double ridgelines, and color gradients.'
- Seamless integration between jamovi graphical interface and automated R syntax generation.
- Rigorous handling of missing data, small cohorts, and multi-variable stratification.

# Example Workflow in R

```r
library(ClinicoPathJamoviModule)

# Load package test dataset
data("jjridges_test_data", package = "ClinicoPathJamoviModule", envir = environment())

# Run analysis with default settings
# ClinicoPathJamoviModule::jjridges(
#   data = jjridges_test_data
# )
```

# Clinical & Statistical Interpretation

Outputs generated by `jjridges` include summary tables, diagnostic indicators, and high-resolution plots tailored for oncology, pathology, and clinical trial reporting.
